review_basis: The registration defines the requested 16-cell one-factor-at-a-time sweep: env count, inference device, thread count, and rollout length vary in the registered pairs. Threads are explicitly confounded between Torch intraop and native Rayon; this is not a full factorial design.

Profile imports the pinned runtime from the registered runtime_root, checks loaded dodge_rl module paths and hashes against input_pins, verifies the exact lease and all input pins, and loads checkpoint 420 onto CPU before strict model restore.

For CPU inference cells, learner and Adam optimizer are separately restored on MPS; for MPS inference cells, learner and inference model share the MPS instance. Adam state is loaded onto optimizer-owned parameters through PyTorch load_state_dict. PPO rollout storage is CPU per pinned PPO API. No checkpoint or trained weights are saved.

The collector and boundary adapter wiring follows pinned collect_rollout and _finish_after_ppo contracts. Full rollout decision counts are checked by the launcher. Seeds come only from registered training-pool512 values and exclude registered ranges; no new seed cohort is introduced.

Launcher enforces exclusive launch and per-cell claims, stops after first failure, directly waits/reaps each child, checks process-group absence, retains the lease on failure, checks receipts and pins before terminal audit, then clears only the matching lease after audit creation.

The registration specifies separate 6 GiB RSS and MPS thresholds. The profile checks process high-water RSS and sampled MPS driver allocation; MPS allocator fraction is capped below the threshold. Launcher also samples aggregate parent-plus-child RSS. No resource behavior was measured in this source-only review.

Timing instrumentation synchronizes MPS around measured transfers and forwards, separates native step/reset, observation validation/copy, collection forwarding/transfer, GAE, and residual collection work. PPO total includes nested forward/transfer; registration correctly says those nested counters are attribution, not additive. Setup and initial environment construction are outside update timing.
limits: Source review only. Source compilation was reported by parent; this review did not compile or execute code, import Torch, profile, interact with game state, inspect or mutate leases/markers/ledger/notebook, or validate runtime behavior.

No result establishes actual MPS/RSS ceiling enforcement, exact-once behavior under interruption, checkpoint immutability after execution, performance, or safe completion. Runtime qualification remains pending execution evidence and parent audit.
The 16 registered cells are a one-factor-at-a-time subset. Thread count changes both Torch intraop and native Rayon, and setup/initial constructor cost is excluded from update timing.
